verdict: preparation corrections verified; no remaining identified launch blocker in bounded source review
scope: Read-only local review of paired control/candidate measurement, selective native execution proof and output gates. No browser, GPU, network or remote commands executed.

resolved_findings.issue: Decoder finiteness checked only after denormalization/clamp
resolved_findings.resolution: frame wraps pipe.vae.decode, checks raw tensor before postprocess, requires both raw decoder and converter guards, and restores methods in finally. Quality and temporal samples enable guards; timed frames do not add validation synchronization.

resolved_findings.issue: Eager microkernel evidence did not attest compiled full-model module swaps
resolved_findings.resolution: One warmed untimed frame per shape/config records GPU kernel events matching both dense_blockscaled_gemm_sm120_b12x and f4E2M1FN. Native launch count must equal 0/5/10 for FP8/image_ff_in/image_ff_both. Exactly one terminal skip is checked. CPU custom-op count is informational because CUDA graph replay may omit it.

resolved_findings.issue: LPIPS NaN could be serialized without failing assessment
resolved_findings.resolution: LPIPS explicitly rejects nonfinite values; assessment JSON forbids NaN.

resolved_findings.issue: Timing gain discarded matched pair identity
resolved_findings.resolution: Unique pair/variant keys and formal 100-frame/3-pair matrix are required, FPS is reconciled with observed wall time, and matched pair ratios/deltas are primary. Ratio of arm medians remains explicitly named.

preclamp_guard_cpu_source_mocks: original decoder/converter restored after success and failure
checks.paired_controls: Same worker/environment, original BF16 source weights quantized to selected FP4 only, other FP8 modules retained; seed/prompt/input JPEG bytes/steps/alpha/native threads/terminal skip/output cast fixed. Alternating sequential order and exact FP8 return checks retained.
checks.quality_matrix: 54 paired fixtures per candidate (3 resolutions x 3 prompts x 2 seeds x 3 input phases), plus 12-frame deterministic clips per variant/resolution; numerical full-resolution PNG evidence and separate previews.
checks.timing_boundary: Observed synchronized wall time includes JPEG input decode, VAE encode/generate, output/JPEG80 and CUDA completion; excludes prompt embedding, profiler, PNG writing and image metrics.

limitations: Full-model run has not executed. Profile counts and preclamp guards are preparation logic, not measured full-model correctness, performance or FP4 execution evidence.
Native kernel gate is an eager representative-layer microbenchmark and is not full-model or live application speed.
Finite tensors can still be artistically poor. Temporal LPIPS/frame-delta RMS are descriptive; no scalar metric automatically accepts output. Independent visual/temporal acceptance remains pending.
Both alternatives remain resident in one comparison process; memory numbers are not standalone deployment footprint.
Analyzer intentionally accepts the formal default 100 frames x 3 pairs; non-default probe counts would require an explicitly updated assessment contract.
No production promotion or UI behavior change is authorized by this preparation verdict.
